title: elzle Solar Power Bank 26800 mAh for Camping — 4 Solar Panels, LED Torch
short_description: Solar power bank by elzle with 26800 mAh, 4 foldable solar panels, USB-A and USB-C ports and an LED torch — for camping, hiking and outdoors.
long_description: The elzle solar power bank (model YD-820S) has a capacity of 26800 mAh and 4 foldable solar panels according to Amazon. It offers USB-A and USB-C ports (3 USB ports in total) and a built-in LED torch. According to Amazon it includes automatic shut-off as well as short-circuit and overcharge protection. The power bank weighs 535 g. According to Amazon the box contains a USB-C cable, a carabiner and a user manual. Please check the exact details and scope of delivery on the Amazon product page before buying.
features: USB-A and USB-C ports, 3 USB ports
